.create-or-alter function with (docstring = "Formats dead-letter telemetry exception logs for DataOps Observability Dashboard") 
get_dead_letter_audit_log(window_minutes:int = 60) {
    DeadLetterTelemetry
    | extend fac_id_val = tostring(column_ifexists("facility_id", ""))
    | extend facility_id_str = iff(isempty(fac_id_val) or isnull(fac_id_val), "NULL_FACILITY_ID", toupper(fac_id_val))
    | extend exception_status = iff(facility_id_str == "NULL_FACILITY_ID", "CRITICAL_MISSING_PRIMARY_KEY", "DEPRECATED_SCHEMA_EVENT")
    | extend ingestion_timestamp = ingestion_time()
    | extend payload_timestamp = ingestion_timestamp
    | project ingestion_timestamp, event_id, event_type, exception_status, payload_timestamp
    | sort by ingestion_timestamp desc
}

// 1. Unified Pipeline Execution Log Table (Traces every Medallion run)
.create-merge table DataOpsPipelineLog (
    TraceID: string,
    SpanId: string,
    PipelineName: string,
    StageName: string,
    Component: string,
    ExecutionStatus: string,
    SourceRowCount: long,
    TargetRowCount: long,
    ExecutionDurationMs: long,
    ErrorMessage: string,
    Timestamp: datetime
)

.rename column DataOpsPipelineLog.TraceID to TraceId

// 2. Ingestion Latency Tracker Table (Measures Edge-to-KQL lag)
.create-merge table IngestionLatencyTracker (
    EventId: string,
    FacilityId: string,
    StreamName: string,
    EdgeGenerationTime: datetime,
    EventstreamIngestTime: datetime,
    KQLStorageTime: datetime,
    TotalLagSeconds: real,
    Timestamp: datetime
)

// 3. Quality & Schema Drift Audit Log Table (Tracks quarantine & defect rates)
.create-merge table QualityAuditLog (
    AuditId: string,
    TableName: string,
    ValidationRule: string,
    Severity: string,
    DefectCount: long,
    TotalAuditedCount: long,
    DefectPercentage: real,
    AuditStatus: string,
    Timestamp: datetime 
)

// Func 1: Pipeline Execution SLA & Success Rates
.create-or-alter function fn_DataOpsPipelineSLA() {
    DataOpsPipelineLog
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | summarize 
        TotalRuns = count(),
        SuccessfulRuns = countif(ExecutionStatus == "SUCCESS"),
        FailedRuns = countif(ExecutionStatus  == "FAILED"),
        AvgDurationSec = round(avg(ExecutionDurationMs) / 1000.0, 2),
        MaxDurationSec = round(max(ExecutionDurationMs) / 1000.0, 2),
        TotalRowsProcessed = sum(TargetRowCount)
    by PipelineName, StageName
    | extend SuccessRatePct = round((SuccessfulRuns * 100.0) / TotalRuns, 2)
}

// Func 2: Real-Time Ingestion Lag Percentiles (P50, P95, P99)
.create-or-alter function fn_StreamIngestionLagMetrics() {
    IngestionLatencyTracker
    | where Timestamp > ago(24h)
    | summarize 
        P50_Lag_Sec = round(percentile(TotalLagSeconds, 50), 2),
        P95_Lag_Sec = round(percentile(TotalLagSeconds, 95), 2),
        P99_Lag_Sec = round(percentile(TotalLagSeconds, 99), 2),
        Max_Lag_Sec = round(max(TotalLagSeconds), 2),
        TotalEvents = count()
    by StreamName, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
}

// Func 3: Data Quality Gate & SLA Compliance Status
.create-or-alter function fn_DataOpsQualityGateStatus() {
    QualityAuditLog
    | where Timestamp > ago(24h)
    | summarize 
        TotalDefects = sum(DefectCount),
        TotalRecords = sum(TotalAuditedCount)
    by TableName, ValidationRule
    | extend OverallDefectRatePct = round((TotalDefects * 100.0) / TotalRecords, 4)
    | extend  SLA_Compliance = iff(OverallDefectRatePct < 0.1, "COMPLIANT (<0.1%)", "BREACH (>=0.1%)")
}

// 1. Retention Policy for DataOpsPipelineLog (30 Days)
.alter table DataOpsPipelineLog policy retention @'{"SoftDeletePeriod": "30.00:00:00", "Recoverability": "Enabled"}'

// 2. Retention Policy for IngestionLatencyTracker (30 Days)
.alter table IngestionLatencyTracker policy retention @'{"SoftDeletePeriod": "30.00:00:00", "Recoverability": "Enabled"}'

// 3. Retention Policy for QualityAuditLog (30 Days)
.alter table QualityAuditLog policy retention @'{"SoftDeletePeriod": "30.00:00:00", "Recoverability": "Enabled"}'

// Create the Latency Tracking table
.create-merge table IngestionLatencyTracker (
    EventId: string,
    FacilityId: string,
    StreamName: string,
    EdgeTime: string,
    IngestionTime: string,
    LagSeconds: real
)

// 1. Environmental Telemetry Latency Function
.create-or-alter function fn_TrackEnvIngestionLatency() {
    EnvironmentalTelemetry
    | project 
        EventId = tostring(event_id),
        FacilityId = tostring(facility_id),
        StreamName = "EnvironmentalTelemetry",
        EdgeTime = todatetime(timestamp),
        IngestionTime = todatetime(IngestionTime),
        LagSeconds = round(todouble(datetime_diff('millisecond', todatetime(IngestionTime), todatetime(timestamp))) / 1000.0, 2)
}

.create table IngestionLatencyTracker (
    EventId: string,
    FacilityId: string,
    StreamName: string,
    EdgeTime: datetime,
    IngestionTime: datetime,
    LagSeconds: real 
)

.alter table IngestionLatencyTracker policy retention @'{"SoftDeletePeriod": "30.00:00:00", "Recoverability": "Enabled"}'

.show table IngestionLatencyTracker policy update

.create-or-alter function fn_StreamIngestionLagMetrics() {
    IngestionLatencyTracker
    | where IngestionTime > ago(24h)
    | summarize 
        P50_Lag_Sec = round(percentile(LagSeconds, 50), 2),
        P95_Lag_Sec = round(percentile(LagSeconds, 95), 2),
        P99_Lag_Sec = round(percentile(LagSeconds, 99), 2),
        Max_Lag_Sec = round(max(LagSeconds), 2),
        TotalEvents = count()
      by StreamName, bin(IngestionTime, 1h)
}

.clear table DataOpsPipelineLog data;
.clear table IngestionLatencyTracker data;
.clear table QualityAuditLog data;

// Alert Function 1: Detect Any Batch Stage Failure in the last 1 hour
.create-or-alter function fn_AlertPipelineFailure() {
    DataOpsPipelineLog
    | where Timestamp > ago(1h)
    | where ExecutionStatus == "FAILED"
    | project Timestamp, TraceId, StageName, Component, ErrorMessage
}

// Alert Function 2: Detect Batch SLA Duration Breach (> 15 minutes / 900,000ms)
.create-or-alter function fn_AlertBatchSLABreach() {
    DataOpsPipelineLog
    | where Timestamp > ago(24h)
    | summarize TotalBatchDurationMs = sum(ExecutionDurationMs) by TraceId, bin(Timestamp, 1d)
    | where TotalBatchDurationMs > 900000
    | project Timestamp, TraceId, TotalDurationSec = TotalBatchDurationMs / 1000.0, SLA_Status = "SLA BREACH (> 15 MIN)"
}
